summary: Duplicate capture can occur after provider timeout and retry
description: A retry sent after a delayed provider response can create two capture attempts when the idempotency record has not propagated.
acceptanceCriteria: Only one provider capture is created
The client receives the original correlation ID
A duplicate retry is observable in metrics

summary: Payment failover returns an unhelpful generic error
description: The secondary provider succeeds but the API response still reports the primary-provider timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Record both provider attempts in the audit log

summary: Warehouse route is not recalculated after inventory update
description: An order retains the original warehouse after inventory is reduced below the requested quantity.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve the routing decision in order history

summary: Rotate refresh tokens after successful use
description: A successfully used refresh token is invalidated and replaced atomically.
acceptanceCriteria: New token preserves the expected session scope
Rotation is included in the security audit log

summary: Review release-gate waiver for partial fulfilment
description: Document the impact, owner and expiry date for the two conditional high-severity defects.
